# Comfy PixVerse 6.0- Text to Video

Generate videos up to 15 seconds at 1080p from text prompts with PixVerse V6, supporting multiple aspect ratios, optional integrated audio, and multi-shot scene direction in a single generation. Ideal for social media ads, product concept testing, and short-form storytelling where narrative continuity and distribution-ready framing matter. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_pixverse6_t2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt: single continuous shot, 8K CG animated film aesthetic, shallow depth of field, motion blur, soft-dramatic contrast lighting, anatomically correct, consistent costume details, realistic skin texture with visible pores, sweat sheen, and subtle blemishes. Quick arcing orbit camera inside ruined moonlit temple. Two martial artists in linen traditional robes, hand-to-hand close-quarters combat. Fluid blocks, palm strikes, quick evasive twists. Broken roof lets silver moonlight pour down, thin mist curls across stone floor. Stone dust kicks up with each heavy footfall. Muted cool silver-indigo palette. Robes ripple dynamically with every body shift. Detailed facial rendering with natural skin texture and micro-expressions, costume ornaments consistent through fast motion.
